# AI-augmented

> The front page of a family of repositories on AI-augmented work: a person, a language model and a machine on one project. The map, the shared words, and the rule of one repository per problem with no overlap, with the principles that rule rests on.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension.

## Standard

- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/standard.md): the one-page card to follow, with every principle and its grade
- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository

## Claims: saying that a person with a model does better

- [Compare with each part alone](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/principles/claims/compare-with-each-part-alone.md): a claim that a person with a model does better sets the combination against the person alone and the model alone.

## Scope: what each member of the family owns

- [One owner per claim](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/principles/scope/one-owner-per-claim.md): a thing is in the scope of one member of the family, and every other member links it.
- [A scope table says why](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/principles/scope/scope-table-with-why.md): a member's scope is a table of in, later and out rows, and every row says why.

## Optional

- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/evidence/README.md): one literature review per topic, with the evidence against
- [Bibliography](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/evidence/bibliography.md): every cited work, once
- [Shapes](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/shapes/README.md): skeletons for kinds of documents
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented/decisions/README.md): the choices this repository made, one record each
